cast.name: 玛丽安·伊丽莎白 Marian Elizabeth

introduction: Tim and Cathryn are a couple in their early 40's. They haven't really gotten anywhere in life - no career, no college, no direction, no ambition and no kids... And now that the biological clock is ticking they have decided that the most important thing for them is to have a baby. Something that they, like many other couples their age, discover is harder than they imagined. After months of trying with no luck, they go to a fertility specialist who suggests they go the IVF route. However, it is going to cost them $25K per insemination. Since this is way out of their financial range they have to go back to the drawing board, doing it the old fashion way. Flash forward to a month later - desperation has set in... Tim has performance problems and he is missing the romance and intimacy, whilst all Cathryn can think about is ovulation charts and babies.
